subject.title: [Bug]: Docker Install + Sandbox can't workspaceAccess at all

question: Should OpenClaw automatically translate Gateway-container paths to host paths for Docker-outside-of-Docker sandbox binds, or should Docker Gateway installs continue to require an explicit identical host/container path mapping?
rationale: Both directions affect the sandbox security boundary: automatic translation broadens trusted bind-source resolution, while the current documented contract leaves Docker users with fragile manual setup for `workspaceAccess`.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded host-path mapping design
options.body: Add a narrow, audited mapping mechanism that preserves bind-source allowlists, rejects Docker socket/credential exposure, updates Docker setup/docs, and includes DooD E2E proof.

options.title: Keep the explicit identical-path contract
options.body: Treat this as an operator setup requirement, improve doctor/setup diagnostics, and close or narrow related code-fix proposals that try to infer host paths automatically.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded host-path mapping design
recommendation.body: Add a narrow, audited mapping mechanism that preserves bind-source allowlists, rejects Docker socket/credential exposure, updates Docker setup/docs, and includes DooD E2E proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans sandbox runtime, Docker setup, and security defaults; the sampled history points to steipete as the strongest current code-path owner.
